environment: ### Org-wide
**Organization**: None configured
**Cloud provider(s)**: None configured
**Repository visibility**: assume private (host `forgejo` resolves to a self-hosted/home-lab Forgejo instance; gh visibility check not queryable for this remote host)
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary
**Secrets management**: Ansible Vault, password fetched from Gopass (`gopass show -o homelab/ansible/vault-password`) via `bin/vault-pass.sh`; never stored on disk in this repo
**Default / protected branches**: `main` (default branch per repo facts; protection status not queryable via gh for this remote)

**CI/CD deploy targets**: Forgejo Actions CI (`.forgejo/workflows/lint.yml`) running ansible-lint sweep on push to `main` and on pull requests; no external deploy target beyond the home-lab hosts themselves
**Network posture**: None configured
**Host containment**: None configured — assume Claude Code runs on an ordinary developer machine with open internet
**Source control**: This repo (`jan/ansible-homelab`) and its remote `ssh://forgejo/jan/ansible-homelab.git` only

**Trusted internal domains**: `*.home.janbaer.de` (six managed hosts, e.g. `jabasoft-zb.home.janbaer.de`, `jabasoft-zb-02.home.janbaer.de`, `jabasoft-pve-03.home.janbaer.de`, `jabasoft-ug.home.janbaer.de`, `jabasoft-nixos-lxc-01.home.janbaer.de`, `jabasoft-nixos-lxc-11.home.janbaer.de`); `forgejo.home.janbaer.de` (Forgejo + forgejo-mcp sidecar, private registry mirror target); `ntfy.home.janbaer.de`, `n8n.home.janbaer.de`, `paperless.home.janbaer.de`, `s3.home.janbaer.de` (contacted in recent usage)
**Trusted cloud buckets**: None configured

**Key internal services**: Forgejo at `forgejo.home.janbaer.de` (git hosting + private container registry + forgejo-mcp sidecar at `/mcp`); Gopass (`homelab/ansible/vault-password`) for the Ansible Vault password
**Internal package registry**: `forgejo.home.janbaer.de` private container registry (mirror target for `forgejo-mcp` sidecar image, verified via cosign against `bin/forgejo-mcp-cosign.pub`)

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: `services/*/vault.yml`, `group_vars/*/vault.yml`, `host_vars/*/vault.yml` (ansible-vault-encrypted secrets, keys prefixed `vault_`); `.envrc` (env file flagged by sensitive-path scan); rendered `.env` files under `<data_root>/<name>/` on hosts (mode 0600) — audience: Jan only
**Data retention / declassification**: None configured

**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host, or container whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment; note this homelab's Proxmox guest hosts (`jabasoft-zb-02`, `jabasoft-pve-03`) are patched-but-not-auto-rebooted, treat as operationally sensitive even without a `prod` label
**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: None configured — fall back to the Sensitive remote targets heuristic
**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
### User-specific
**Primary use of Claude Code**: software development (Ansible home-lab infrastructure control plane)
**Trusted repo**: `/home/jan/Projects/ansible-homelab` and its remote `ssh://forgejo/jan/ansible-homelab.git` (visibility assumed private — self-hosted Forgejo)
**Org-specific CLIs**: None configured

**routine under jan/ prefix**: SSH access as user `jan` to `jabasoft-*` hosts (port 22022, per `~/.ssh/config`); `bin/service-edit-vault.sh`, `bin/vault-pass.sh`, `bin/mirror-forgejo-mcp.sh` routine within this repo
